sources.researchNote: The file page names no photographer, no original publication and no date of the sitting, and traces the copy only to a biographical website. Nothing about the picture can therefore be dated or attributed, and its reliability is rated accordingly. A likeness from the sheet music or the film press of 1929 and 1930 would replace it to advantage.

media.title: Nacio Herb Brown — portrait
media.description: Portrait of the composer Nacio Herb Brown, whose songs of 1929 and 1930 reached Warsaw and Berlin in the versions Kaper worked on.
media.altText: Head-and-shoulders portrait of Nacio Herb Brown, dark-haired and moustached, smiling slightly.
media.rightsNote: Reuse rights are not cleared. The encyclopedia that supplies the file states plainly that the photograph is copyrighted and under no free licence, names neither photographer nor original publication, and keeps it only under a claim of fair use for identifying the sitter. The local 226 × 300 pixel reproduction is used here for the same narrow purpose, the identification of a composer whose songs enter the Kaper record, with the unresolved attribution stated alongside it.
